body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution seat (`session_01Gqi43smmqjJ5sUrhfoPeKu`, seat post #7623) out of the #18811 round (PR #18827), from the dev's victim search, re-read by the seat before filing. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only, `domain:*` / type / priority are triage's (lane self-triage exception noted). ⛔ Adjacent to #18764 (the marker vs a DECORATED body — closed by PR #18824 through the sibling's reading) and to #18828 (a forbidden SECOND `Claim:`): this is a third shape — a claim written in a spelling the contract never permitted, by seats that did not write the record's first line.

Dedupe words: `Claim heading not marker` · `CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER misses claim` · `claim spelling drift` · `## Claim vs Claim:` · `governing claim pool spelling` · `identity record contract`.

## The reading, at 2026-09-17T22:55Z–22:56Z (the #18811 dev's victim search; every row may have left this state since) and `origin/main` `5941246b70`

- The contract: `AGENTS.md` :394–:395 「the identity record is the `Claim:` comment — first line beginning `Claim:`」; the reader implements exactly that — `CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER` at `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` :1138 (`Claim` or `Claimed`, colon, line start, case-insensitive, one blockquote allowed; since PR #18756 read through `markerMatches`, which strips markdown decoration and refuses a list item).
- Four OPEN cards carry a real claim the marker cannot see, each under a same-number stray head on `origin` (which is how the search found them):

| card | the claim, as written | comment |
|---|---|---|
| #15638 (`bug` `pm:queue` `domain:cli` p3) | a `## Claim` heading plus 「Claimed by the os-dev seat」 in prose | 5555005915 |
| #14512 (`pm:queue` `domain:spec` p3) | 「Claiming the producer half」 in prose | 5523309738 |
| #11633 (`tracking` `domain:services` `pm:blocking`) | a `## Claim + dispatch` heading | 5394770585 |
| #11663 (p0 `security` `tracking` `domain:services` `pm:epic`) | a `## Claim + dispatch` heading | 5394306066 |

Every marker-reading tool — the pair gate's governing-claim pool, the half-states sweep, the pre-check reading PR #18827 lands — reads those four as UNCLAIMED. Two of them carry `pm:queue`, so a seat taking the total order today would dispatch a card someone has claimed in prose.

## What this is, and is not

- ⛔ Not a reader defect: the contract names one spelling and the reader honours it; widening the reader to headings and prose is what #18680 refused (decoration is an open set answered by a NAMED vocabulary, not a wider reader) and what H20 pins against for list items.
- It IS a writer-side drift with a measured cost: four identity records that no instrument can see. The remedy per the protocol is on each card — a `Claim:` line by the holder (or a `Release:` if the holder is gone), and the `OWNERSHIP_MARKER_NEAR_MISS_FORMS` vocabulary may deserve the two heading forms as NAMED near misses so the sweep sounds on them instead of reading absence.

## ⛔ Not measured

- Whether any of the four holders is still active (the claims date from 2026-08 / 2026-09-13; the seat did not probe the sessions).
- The population beyond the 27 cards the victim search reached (only cards under a stray head were read).
